invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$2115.8125（入场价-3%），或Qlib评分跌出前三，或融资费率Z-score超过100%（显示多头过度拥挤）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $2115.8125 (entry -3%), or Qlib score falls out of top 3, or funding Z-score exceeds 100% (indicating overly crowded longs).

invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $71000 (entry -3%), or Qlib score drops out of top 3, or funding Z-score exceeds 100% (overly crowded longs), or daily RSI falls below 50.
